title: Remote peer exceeds 10 GB in a rolling hour
summary: Measure observed per-socket TCP byte deltas by remote IP and alert when a peer crosses its hourly 10,000,000,000-byte budget.
data: Complete per-socket TCP counters; pauses and restarts the window after unreadable or timed-out scans.
risk: Elevated if a user chooses the firewall response
response: Notify by default; an address-wide TCP block requires preview plus explicit confirmation.
script:
# WinTCP Script v1
# T01: Inspect the traffic-enriched connection rows. This one-time view is not a rolling hourly peer counter.
# Runs only the sibling wintcp.exe CLI. It does not create a monitor or run in the background.
let result = list --format json --traffic --sort nettotal --desc --limit 50
if result.exitCode == 0
  print "Inspect the traffic-enriched connection rows. This one-time view is not a rolling hourly peer counter."
else
  print "CLI exit ${result.exitCode}: ${result.stderr}"
end
